```{r}
create_volcano_plot <- function(
    data,
    x_col       = "logfoldchanges",
    p_col       = "pvals_adj",
    score_col   = "scores",
    gene_col    = "names",
    logFC_thresh = 1,
    p_thresh     = 0.05,
    y_max        = NULL,
    label_top_n  = NULL,
    label_genes  = NULL,
    x_label      = "Log2(fold change)",
    y_label      = "-Log10(p-value)"
) {
  
  x_data <- data[[x_col]]
  p_data <- data[[p_col]]
  score  <- data[[score_col]]
  y_data <- -log10(p_data)
  
  data$color_group <- dplyr::case_when(
    x_data >  logFC_thresh & p_data < p_thresh ~ "Upregulated",
    x_data < -logFC_thresh & p_data < p_thresh ~ "Downregulated",
    TRUE                                       ~ "Not significant"
  )
  data$color_group[is.na(data$color_group)] <- "Not significant"
  
  plot_data <- data.frame(
    x      = x_data,
    y      = y_data,
    score  = score,
    gene   = data[[gene_col]],
    color_group = data$color_group,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  label_subset <- NULL
  
  if (!is.null(label_top_n) && label_top_n > 0) {
    top_up <- plot_data %>%
      filter(color_group == "Upregulated") %>%
      arrange(desc(score)) %>%
      slice_head(n = label_top_n)
    
    top_down <- plot_data %>%
      filter(color_group == "Downregulated") %>%
      arrange(score) %>% 
      slice_head(n = label_top_n)
    
    label_subset <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(label_genes)) {
    manual <- plot_data %>% filter(gene %in% label_genes)
    
    if (is.null(label_subset)) {
      label_subset <- manual
    } else {
      label_subset <- bind_rows(label_subset, manual) %>%
        distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = color_group)) +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFC_thresh, logFC_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Upregulated"      = "#cb5f51",
        "Downregulated"    = "#6292ca",
        "Not significant"  = "gray70"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label, color = NULL) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  if (!is.null(y_max)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max))
  }
  
  if (!is.null(label_subset) && nrow(label_subset) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_text_repel(
      data = label_subset,
      aes(label = gene),
      size = 3.5,
      segment.color = "black",
      segment.size = 0.3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      nudge_x = 0.25,
      nudge_y = 0.25,
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  return(p)
}

```

```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4}
cts <- c('Alveolar', 'Adventitial', 'Inflammatory', 'SMCs', 'Peribronchial')

for (ct in cts) {
  ct_path <- paste0("/fs/ess/PAS2148/huchen/fibroblasts_data/", "Lung_tissue_", ct, "_DEGs.xlsx")
  deg_ul <- read_excel(ct_path, sheet = 'IPF upper lobe')
  deg_ll <- read_excel(ct_path, sheet = 'IPF lower lobe')
  
  p1 <- create_volcano_plot(
    data        = deg_ul,
    x_col       = "logfoldchanges",
    p_col       = "pvals_adj",
    gene_col    = "names",
    logFC_thresh = 1,
    p_thresh     = 0.05,
    label_top_n  = 10
  )
  ggsave(file.path(save.path, paste0(ct, "_IPF_UL", "_Volcano.pdf")), p1, width = 5, height = 4)
  print(p1)
  p2 <- create_volcano_plot(
    data        = deg_ll,
    x_col       = "logfoldchanges",
    p_col       = "pvals_adj",
    gene_col    = "names",
    logFC_thresh = 1,
    p_thresh     = 0.05,
    label_top_n  = 10
  )
  
  ggsave(file.path(save.path, paste0(ct, "_IPF_LL", "_Volcano.pdf")), p2, width = 5, height = 4)
  print(p2)
}
```
